hooks.command: echo 'SESSION RESUME (genzen): Before anything else, resolve the current user via `gh api user --jq .login` (fallback: the single file in continue/). Read continue/<login>.md if it exists and greet the user in 2-3 lines summarizing where THEY left off, then run `gh issue list` for relevant open issues and ask if they want to continue that work. If they ask where everyone is at / what another user did, read the other continue/*.md files plus `git log --author`. If no file matches and none exists, say so briefly. If they decline or open a different task, drop it.'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); echo "$input" | grep -qF "git commit" || exit 0; login=$(gh api user --jq .login 2>/dev/null) || true; [ -z "$login" ] && exit 0; file="continue/${login}.md"; git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^${file}$" && exit 0; echo "Stage continue/${login}.md before committing -- it is the cross-machine resume pointer."; exit 1'
